method.fixedComparison: Exact prior matched GPCC-valid land support, same 48x24 remap and source geometry. No observations, supports, dates or parameters modified.
method.humidity: Specific humidity in g/kg. RH proxy is area-mean [monthly q / qsat(monthly T, monthly ps*sigma)] using the exact model Clausius-Clapeyron constants. It is not mean instantaneous RH.
method.theta: Potential temperature proxy from monthly T and ps. Static stability between levels 7/8 is theta7-theta8; a monthly mean cannot diagnose episodic convection.
method.alternativeSupport: nativeBoxLand is Gaussian quadrature times native land fraction in the fixed bounds; nativeLandMaskedFixedSupport first remaps with native land mask, then uses old GPCC support. These are sensitivity checks, not replacements for the frozen comparison.
method.solar: Analytic daily average of the default SinSolarDeclination/Earth formula, evaluated on each day at 12 UTC. Source-code phase audit, not replay of archived instantaneous cos_zenith.
